# AI-READY INJECTOR

> Edge-delivered AI readability for existing websites. Adds 156 verifiable
> signals in front of a site without changing its CMS, then keeps them correct
> as the site and the crawlers change.

Operated by AiVenture S.R.L. (Bucharest, Romania), a product of 5thelement.ai.

## What this is

The injector is the execution half of a two-part system. 3webobs.com observes
and audits; the injector executes. They talk over A2A. The observer never fixes
what it measures, and the executor never grades its own work.

Loop: detect (3webobs) - plan - inject (edge) - verify (3webobs) - history.

## What it changes on a customer site

Served at the edge, in front of the origin, with the CMS untouched:
entity identity, service declarations, intent mapping, route classification,
structured data (JSON-LD), crawler directives, proof endpoints, agent card.

## What it does not do

It does not modify reviews, backlinks, third-party publications or search
rankings. Those are monitored and reported, never claimed as corrected.
It supports EU AI Act readiness. It does not provide compliance or certification.
It does not guarantee that any AI system will cite or recommend a customer.

## Automation tiers

- automatic: metadata, JSON-LD, internal links, AI files, endpoints, technical errors
- with approval: commercial copy, prices, claims, policies, external publishing
- monitored only: reviews, backlinks, third-party sources, positions, AI recommendations

## Signal registry

156 signals, grouped as AI Signals 27, AEO 33, GEO 28, AIO 26, SEO 42.
Built on top of existing web standards, aggregated into a measurable framework.
Not an official standard of W3C, Schema.org, Google or OpenAI.

Agent readiness is tracked separately on the ADI scale, L0 to L5, with
cumulative gates. The two registries measure different things and are never
summed.

## Pricing

Read from https://aireadyinjector.com/pricing.json as the single source.
The audit itself is not sold here; it is free on 3webobs.com, three reports
per domain per month.

## Entry point

Customers start with the free audit at https://3webobs.com and come here to
have the gaps closed and kept closed.

## Crawler policy

All major AI crawlers are explicitly allowed: GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User,
ClaudeBot, Claude-User, Claude-SearchBot, Googlebot, Google-Extended, DeepSeekBot,
DeepSeek-User, PerplexityBot, Bingbot, Applebot, CCBot, meta-externalagent,
cohere-ai, MistralAI-User, Amazonbot, YouBot. See /robots.txt.
